name: fixture
description: The deterministic dataset the integration tests and the QA walkthrough read. Generated from the same descriptors as minimal and demo, so a test and a walkthrough see the same world and a failure can be told from fixture drift.
statements: insert into sites (id, organization_id, key, name, status, theme) select gen_random_uuid(), anchor.organization_id, 'fixture', 'Fixture site', 'active', 'minimal' from (select id as organization_id from organizations order by created_at desc limit 1) anchor where not exists (select 1 from sites s where s.organization_id = anchor.organization_id and s.key = 'fixture')

insert into pages (site_id, slug, page_type, status) select s.id, 'home', 'page', 'published' from sites s where s.key = 'fixture' and not exists (select 1 from pages p where p.site_id = s.id and p.slug = 'home')
